cover_letter:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm writing to apply for the UI/UX Designer role in Ghent. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I design and build websites end to end, and I'd love to bring that mix to Qargo's design system.

My work sits where design, code and content meet. I designed and built baverok.com myself in WordPress/Elementor, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data and accessible markup. For mirook.com, I built a multi-page site with JSON-LD schema and knowledge-graph markup, then ran iterative audits that measurably raised its search-health score. At Episto, I'm currently building and maintaining majistraleczacilari.org.tr, where I created a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages, and I manage store design and product catalogues for two Shopify stores. Earlier, at KXP, I designed and built client websites from site structure to content, and at ViviDoctor I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application in AngularJS and JavaScript.

I use Claude and other AI tools daily to speed up research, prototyping and audits, and I'm comfortable with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium, and happy to work directly with customers, including joining go-lives. I'm quick to understand new product domains and take proactive ownership of design improvements.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Qargo turn its design system into a robust foundation. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
